focus.title: 欧盟拟对华电动汽车加征反补贴关税，中欧磋商进入关键期
focus.summary: 欧盟委员会于6月24日公布了对中国电动汽车反补贴调查的初步裁定，拟对进口自中国的纯电动汽车加征17%至36%的额外关税。中欧双方正就价格承诺等解决方案进行紧急磋商，预计7月4日前作出最终决定。中国商务部表示将采取一切必要措施捍卫产业利益。建议出口企业密切关注税率变动，评估供应链调整方案，并提前与欧洲进口商协商合同中的关税分担条款。
focus.title_en: EU Proposes Anti-Subsidy Tariffs on Chinese EVs; China-EU Talks Enter Critical Phase
focus.summary_en: On June 24, the European Commission published preliminary findings of its anti-subsidy investigation into Chinese electric vehicles, proposing additional tariffs of 17%-36% on battery electric vehicles imported from China. China and the EU are in urgent consultations on solutions such as price undertakings, with a final decision expected by July 4. China's Ministry of Commerce stated it will take all necessary measures to protect industrial interests. Exporters are advised to monitor tariff changes, assess supply chain adjustments, and negotiate tariff-sharing clauses with European importers in advance.

case.title: 美国联邦巡回上诉法院裁定：未注册中国商标不能依据《兰哈姆法》获得跨境保护
case.summary: 2026年6月，美国联邦巡回上诉法院在「深圳华强电子诉美国经销商案」中维持原判，认定中国企业在美未注册的商标不受《兰哈姆法》保护，不能主张商标侵权或不正当竞争。该案警示出海企业：仅凭中国商标注册无法在美获得法律救济，必须提前布局美国商标注册。建议企业在产品进入美国市场前至少6-12个月提交商标申请，并保留使用证据。
case.source: 来源：美国联邦巡回上诉法院判决 · 2026.06
case.title_en: U.S. Federal Circuit Rules: Unregistered Chinese Marks Not Protected Under Lanham Act for Cross-Border Claims
case.summary_en: In June 2026, the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit upheld a lower court ruling in Shenzhen Huaqiang Electronics v. U.S. Distributor, holding that Chinese companies' unregistered trademarks in the U.S. are not protected under the Lanham Act, barring claims for infringement or unfair competition. The case warns Chinese exporters: domestic registration alone offers no legal remedy in the U.S.; proactive U.S. trademark registration is essential. Companies are advised to file trademark applications at least 6-12 months before market entry and maintain evidence of use.
case.source_en: Source: U.S. Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit · 2026.06

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区内地九市试点实施跨境数据流动“白名单”管理，简化合规流程
policy.summary: 国家互联网信息办公室于2026年6月22日发布《粤港澳大湾区数据跨境流动促进办法（试行）》，在深圳、广州等九市试点“白名单”机制。对列入白名单的常见商业数据（如贸易、物流、支付信息）出境实行备案制，免除安全评估。此举将大幅降低企业数据合规成本。建议企业梳理数据分类，争取将自身业务数据纳入白名单，并建立内部数据分级管理制度。
policy.source: 来源：国家互联网信息办公室 · 2026.06.22
policy.title_en: Pilot 'Whitelist' for Cross-Border Data Flows in Nine Greater Bay Area Cities Simplifies Compliance
policy.summary_en: On June 22, 2026, the Cyberspace Administration of China issued the 'Interim Measures on Promoting Cross-Border Data Flows in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area', piloting a whitelist mechanism in nine cities including Shenzhen and Guangzhou. Common commercial data (e.g., trade, logistics, payment information) on the whitelist will be subject to a filing system, exempting security assessments. This will significantly reduce data compliance costs. Companies are advised to classify data, seek inclusion in the whitelist, and establish internal data grading management systems.

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国对华半导体出口管制持续加码，企业应建立“双供应链”与合规内控体系
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国商务部工业安全局（BIS）近期拟进一步扩大对华半导体设备及EDA软件的出口限制，并强化最终用户审查。中国半导体企业应尽快评估现有供应链中的受管制物项，建立“中国+海外”双供应链备份；同时完善出口合规内控体系，包括物项分类、最终用户尽职调查及内部培训。建议聘请专业律师定期开展合规审计，以应对美方突袭检查。
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's view: As U.S. Semiconductor Export Controls Tighten, Firms Should Build Dual Supply Chains and Compliance Systems
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: The U.S. Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) is expected to further expand export restrictions on semiconductor equipment and EDA software to China, and strengthen end-user reviews. Chinese semiconductor companies should promptly assess controlled items in their supply chains, establish 'China + overseas' dual supply chain backups, and enhance internal export compliance systems, including item classification, end-user due diligence, and internal training. It is advisable to engage professional lawyers for regular compliance audits to prepare for potential U.S. inspections.
